messages:
maya_cs: Kicking off a short VPC readiness drill for customer Velaris — focus: KMS rotation, IAM scoping, audit logs ingestion, and egress/firewall rules. Proposing Tue 09:00 PT (60m). Can infra/security join? I'll take notes for renewal risk items.
liam_se: I can make that window. Please drop the runbook link and the list of tests.
maya_cs: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-readiness — rough plan: 1) create test CMK (if missing) 2) rotate key + validate token refresh 3) send traffic to private endpoint (canary) 4) validate CloudTrail -> S3 -> SIEM latency 5) verify IAM role scoping and assume-role flows.
priya_neteng: I'll own the network tests and packet captures. Need to confirm which ACLs/security groups we can toggle in test account. Also: will verify NAT/egress path for telemetry.
carlos_sec: I'll validate CMK policy and rotation behavior. Quick Q: do we have a test key in their account already? If not, I can create one with a restricted policy. Example snippet for creating a key: ```aws kms create-key --description "velaris-test-cmk" --policy file://velaris-cmk-policy.json```
maya_cs: We have a test key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcdef01-2345-6789-abcd-ef0123456789. Action owners: maya -> runbook + notes, liam -> canary + latency numbers, priya -> network tests, carlos -> KMS + IAM review.
liam_se: For the canary I'll run a small script hitting the private endpoint with a short prompt and measure: RTT, 95p latency, and any 401/403. Will post results here.
priya_neteng: Adding firewall tweak snippet I'll use (will run in dry-mode first): ```gcloud compute firewall-rules update velaris-allow-egress --allow tcp:443 --direction=EGRESS --priority=1000``` (we'll adapt to AWS if needed).
carlos_sec: Also to validate audit ingestion: check CloudTrail delivery status and S3 event notifications. If CloudTrail shows >10min delivery lag or S3 ingestion retries, mark as "audit-ingest-risk" for renewal.
oncall-bot: Reminder: There is a scheduled platform maintenance Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC that may affect key rotation tests if the window extends.
maya_cs: Good catch, we'll avoid overlap. One more ask: can each owner upload a single-line result summary after the drill so I can capture in the account health doc? Example: `KMS: rotation OK, IAM: one overly-broad role found, Network: egress path OK, Audit: 3min ingestion lag`
liam_se: Copy. I'll add 95p latency and token/401 counts.
priya_neteng: Will attach pcap + summary.
carlos_sec: I'll also attach the minimal CMK policy diff if we recommend changes.
maya_cs: Thanks team. Will send calendar invite and the pre-checklist before Tue. Main renewal risk to capture: audit ingestion >10m, persistent 401s after rotation, and any IAM roles with wildcard admins.
liam_se: One note — for the canary I'll run 100 requests spaced over 2 minutes to get a stable 95p.
priya_neteng: I'll do a quick NAT gateway failover test during the window to ensure telemetry still flows.
maya_cs: Perfect. If nothing major blocks, I'll mark the Velaris account health as "on track" in the renewal tracker; otherwise we'll escalate recommended remediations in the renewal briefing. :thumbsup:
